verdict.rationale: Ironclad offers contract signing, including embedded Ironclad Signature and Bring Your Own Signature Provider routing, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions stronger signer identity verification, such as SMS codes, ID document checks, or knowledge-based authentication, or any way to require it on sensitive documents. BYOSP might let a company route signing to a provider that offers such checks, but the evidence never says so, and that would be an unevidenced workaround rather than delivery of the story.
